name: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN: LUCIUS THE ETERNAL
description: Lucius the Eternal is an arrogant slaughterer and swordmaster supreme. He seeks out the most skilled of the foe’s champions, casually cutting down lesser enemies that dare bar his path. Against worthy opponents, Lucius strikes with the speed of a snake, his daemonically sentient lash and blade making a mockery of the greatest warriors.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Lucius the Eternal, a legendary duelist for your Emperor's Children armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. He wields the daemonic Blade of the Laer in one hand, and the Lash of Torment in the other, utterly devastating in both single combat and in taking on hordes of lesser foes. If you crave the exhilaration of close-quarters combat, Lucius is an ideal leader for your force.</br></br>This kit comprises 21 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 50mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
